name: UseWinAppCLI
description: Task for installing the Windows App Developer CLI
author: Microsoft

inputs.name: version
inputs.label: Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Release version: latest or vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, optionally with a prerelease suffix (e.g. v0.2.0-preview.1).

inputs.name: sha256
inputs.label: Expected SHA-256
inputs.helpMarkDown: Expected SHA-256 of the architecture-specific release ZIP. Defaults to the digest from GitHub release metadata.

inputs.name: github-token
inputs.label: GitHub API token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional GitHub token for release metadata requests to avoid unauthenticated rate limits. Pass a secret pipeline variable. Not sent to release downloads.
